newsitem.title: UK: NWE NAPHTHA SWAPS FIRM, PIPELINE SPEC DEAL AT $196.
newsitem.headline: NWE NAPHTHA SWAPS FIRM, PIPELINE SPEC DEAL AT $196.

text.p: Front-month European naphtha swaps on Wednesday stayed ahead of opening values despite significant crude futures losses.
The $0.50 gain on the day on August naphtha swaps in part reflected strengthening physical sentiments that produced a pipeline spec deal to August 15 at $196 CIF NWE.
The deal was confirmed by the NWE petchem player who sold it to a Swiss-based trader.
A British petchem player said he sold 18,000-20,000 tonnes of Russian naphtha to the same trader at published mean plus $3.75, widely seen as a hefty premium.
The physical deals were seen pushing up cargo quotes by around $2, a gain mainly attributed to less naphtha avails from refineries seen maximizing reformer throughput for gasoline.
August and September swap trades later in the day were meanwhile confirmed at $195 and $191.50 respectively, as October continued to be viewed around $0.75 below September.
--Keyvan Hedvat, London newsroom +44 171 542 8185 Latest physical naphtha
